{{Top}}
[[File:Electro-proton_bomb_effect.jpg|thumb|right|300px|[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] suffer the effects of the pulse generated by an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]].]]
An '''electromagnetic pulse''' ('''EMP''') or '''magnetic bombard''' was a powerful [[Force field/Legends|burst]] of electromagnetic radiation. It was often used in weaponry designed to suppress technological systems.

They were primarily used to disable droids and electronics; however, a sufficiently powerful EMP could also kill organic life through electrocution.

==Electromagnetic pulse weaponry==
Electromagnetic pulse weaponry delivered a powerful EMP which overloaded most electronic systems not specifically hardened against such an attack. The effect was somewhat similar to an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] blast.

Military magnapulse weapons were available in several different forms, which were first deployed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and were refined by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] some time before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

Though they were able to reduce an entire planet to a pre-technological state, even destroying enemy shields with one blast, these weapons were used only in relatively small numbers during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

===Operational history===
====Clone Wars usage====
EMP weaponry was favored by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] because of the inherently technological nature of their enemy. The [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] was particularly vulnerable to weaponry which suppressed electronics.

Portable EMP devices such as the [[Electro grenade|EMP grenade]] and the [[Electromagnetic pulse launcher|EMP Launcher]] were used by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to deactivate the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

Air-deployed magnetic pulse bombs known as "[[Droid buster|magpulse busters]]" were also used during the Clone Wars. They were only able to deactivate the enemy [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for brief periods, so they were usually used in concert with [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to destroy large groups of droids.

====Imperial developments====
[[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] produced a weapon known as the [[DEMP Ion Carbine/Legends|DEMP gun]] for the Empire. These weapons were effective against droids, small vehicles, and powered armor. Sufficient exposure to DEMP pulses could harm living beings. This weapon was later refined into the [[Destructive Electromagnetic Pulse 2 ion carbine|DEMP 2]], which was seen in use around [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].

In the form of a magnepulse weapon mounted on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of medium [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] class or above, a magnetic pulse could delivered from orbit. This type of magnetic pulse device carried the risk of being reflected against the attacker, and this risk led to the development of magnapulse bombs.

The magnepulse cluster bomb was approximately the size of a starfighter and could be dropped from orbit by any ship capable of launching [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] fighters. The early versions of the magnepulse cluster bomb were vulnerable to enemy fire, so they were redesigned to integrate [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and evasive flight computers. These devices continued to be used as late as [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], as part of the equipment included with the [[Modular taskforce cruiser]]'s Inquisition Module.

Planetary magnapulse cannons were surface-to-space weapons, used much like [[planetary ion cannon]]s.

====Later refinement====
After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], magnetic pulse ordnance became available in the form of a projectile weapon similar to a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]]. The [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|mag pulse]] warhead was able to suppress the weapon systems of a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] for a short period.

Around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] deployed [[empion mine]]s, which contained both an ion projector and an electromagnetic pulse device.

The [[Shadow Droid]]s used during [[Operation Shadow Hand]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10]]-[[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] carried a small EMP gun.
